headings.text: an alumni at University of South Florida

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 2 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "← Scroll to explore →" above "ATL"; "Github" above "VII"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 5 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Languages", "Frontend", "Backend", "Data").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✈
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.flight-map-panel → radial-gradient(rgba(18, 59, 73, 0.25), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 83 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.relative.flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.relative.flex → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 4 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.flight-archive-split 992px | div.flight-pass-panel 496px | dl.flight-map-summary 496px | section.future-flights-panel 496px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Group" 3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Gate" 3:1 needs 4.5:1; "PASSENGER" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "FLIGHT" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 115 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 235 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 48px (3.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 144px on the left, 160px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 1153px of nothing between: "TIMELINE"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: Only 3 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 3 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "May–Aug 2026" (0px from the right); "Apple Inc" (2px from the right); "Internship" (8px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: The h1 is 18px ("Hi there, I am").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Copyright ©" (13px); "Cuong Luong. All rights reserv" (13px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
